protocol: Postprotocol feasibility diagnostic, all fixed128 uniform heldout pilot centers, no selection by margin or coverage.
ideal_center_ball_upper_bound_reason: Last hidden-layer plus scalar-output noise can change the output by exactly rprime*sqrt(1+Ev), so a same-sign output-margin certificate requires rprime<=(abs(clean_output)-.5)/sqrt(1+Ev).
qualification: Float64 feature-distance diagnostic, not an outward interval proof. Radius is deliberately optimistic for all128 centers. This addresses only the elementary triangle-inequality first-layer-cylinder construction, not arbitrary trusted regions.
